name: Real Good Foods Chicken Enchiladas Grande (Keto/Fiber Warning)
whyItWorks: Uses a processed chicken-and-parmesan shell stuffed with cheese and green sauce. High levels of cheese, added functional fibers, and thick dairy fat can trigger gut distress despite low-carb claims.
prepOrOrderInstructions: High Fat & Dairy Warning: Better to choose standard corn tortilla enchiladas with lean shredded chicken.
